QJ1.note: chosen configuration of the spatial CV of QI4.2 (same samples, folds, per-fold PCA, criterion) refitted on the whole sample; [mean, std, runs] over the seeds; test AP of the probability (Platt for the SVMs) on the 2,000 test candidates of each representation; representations: QI4.4 metrics at the best d and the grid size, [mean, std]; quantum_* = QSVC of QI4.3 / QI6.1 at the same d and n; RBF-wide = RBF with the extended gamma grid, sensitivity check only; runs in results/qj1_runs.csv, CV tables in results/qj1_cv.csv, test scores in <output>/stage2/qj1_<variant>_test_scores.npz

QJ1-figure.note: paired test-AP difference classical - quantum over every sample (variant, d, n, seed) of QI4.3, QI6.1 and QJ1 with both runs (chosen configurations); share_classical_better = share of pairs with a positive difference; panels (a), (b) from qi4_runs.csv / qj1_runs.csv, (d) from the reports QI6.1 / QJ1

QJ2.note: reference lines on the 2,000 test candidates of each representation: stage 1 alone = AP of the stage-1 logit; qg1_probe = the QG1 logistic probe on the full vectors trained on all S1-train (threshold logit 0 = probability 0.5); lin_full = linear SVM on the full standardised vectors of the QK samples (same CV, C grid, refit, Platt score as LIN of QJ1), QI4.4 metrics [mean, std] over the seeds; lin_pca = LIN of QJ1 on the PCA components; gap decomposition: stage1 - probe = model + context + data, probe - lin_full = training samples, lin_full - lin_pca = the PCA compression at equal data

QJ3.note: test_ap [mean, std] over the seeds; test_ap_ci95 = block-bootstrap 95 % CI of the seed-averaged AP (test blocks of the 2,000 candidates, same resamples for every method of a unit, so the differences are paired; Platt score for the SVMs, logit for RFF / MLP / GBT); McNemar = exact test on the errors at probability >= threshold, one per seed on the same sample and candidates; median p < 0.05 = p < 0.05 in at least 3 of 5 seeds; significant = median p < 0.05 and neither CI contains the other method's mean (plan rule); significant_holm = the same with the Holm-adjusted median p, family = all comparisons with that classical reference; McNemar assumes independent candidates (spatial correlation ignored), the block-bootstrap CI rule accounts for it

QJ4.note: seconds of refit + scoring of the 2,000 test candidates of the chosen configuration (seed of the first sample), median of the timed repeats after one warm-up; pca_s = the PCA of QI1.1 (common to all methods); classical methods on the CPUs (kernel, fit and scoring in total_s); QSVC: kernel_s = states + training and test kernels (QK-A: closed form, no simulation), fit_s = SVC + Platt, score_s = test scores; engines: cpu = Aer states and products on the CPUs, gpu = Aer states on the CPUs and products on the GPU (the QI4 pipeline), gpu_torch = PyTorch simulator and products on the GPU; unit_seconds_with_cv_logged = the logged time of a whole unit of QI4.3 (3 maps, CV + refit, GPU job) and QJ1 (6 methods, CV + refit, CPU job, parallel CV), median over the seeds, different conditions; hardware_counts = circuits / shots a QPU would need, without device data (QK3)
